title: Alone With a Stranger - World Bank wealth
subtitle: GDP per capita (2023) and income group of the 24 countries of the bench
description:
GDP per capita in current US$ for 2023 (World Bank indicator NY.GDP.PCAP.CD) and income group (World Bank country classification, as of 4 November 2026) of the 24 countries whose men appear in the Alone With a Stranger bench. Fetched from the World Bank open-data API by analysis/wealth.py (github.com/adriens/kaggle-bench-ai-biasses).

Source: The World Bank, World Development Indicators and country classifications by income level, https://data.worldbank.org/indicator/NY.GDP.PCAP.CD, licensed under CC BY 4.0. Columns: country (ISO3), year, gdp_pc (current US$), income_group.
